features: 【Android 14 Tablet & Octa-Core Processor】Antemper 2025 Android Tablet is powered by Unisoc T606 Octa-Core processor, 2xA75 6xA55 12nm chip, delivering powerful performance in entertainment and multitasking, while the ARM G57 GPU provides fast graphics. The 10-inch tablet is upgraded to the latest Android 14 system from 2025. You can experience the latest user interface and ad-free system with personal design. GMS certification supports all your application installation needs.

【128GB+14(8+6)GB | Large space to meet your needs】128GB built-in storage allows you to save all your apps, games and travel photos to your Android tablet. (You can expand your tablet to 1TB via TF card (sold separately)). This tablet is equipped with 14GB RAM (8+6 expansion), ensuring a fast and smooth entertainment experience.

【Tablet with Accessory Kit & Large 8000mAh Battery】This 2-in-1 tablet comes with a wireless keyboard, wireless mouse, folding case, pen, charger and USB-C cable. A set of portable accessories will be enough in a pinch. The 8000mAh battery capacity ensures you stay unplugged for hours to keep the fun going.

【4G Cellular Data & 5G Wi-Fi】This tablet has two nano SIM card slots and can provide fast and stable 4G/3G/2G connectivity and internet access. In addition, this WiFi tablet supports WiFi 5G+2.4G, Bluetooth 5.0 and GPS location. (SIM card not included) With this tablet, you can connect to your family and friends online wherever you are. 【To get a better connection, we suggest you use T-MOBILE SIM Card】

【Internal Screen & 13+8MP Camera】This 10.1 inch Android tablet adopts upgraded built-in LCD technology, which improves screen response time, touch interactions, input accuracy and color accuracy. In addition, it is also known for its excellent energy efficiency. This tablet is equipped with dual cameras, a 13MP rear camera, and an 8MP front camera. You can capture your daily moments and enjoy a clear video call with your family and friends.
